name: Teal Brick Marketplace — public source
projectPolicy: One Marketplace service and one private persistent volume per customer workspace environment.

source.build: Railway builds the Dockerfile from the public repository; no GHCR pull is required.
source.sourcePinGate: Portal templateDeployV2 must use source.branch=release/marketplace-v0.1.3. The branch is fixed to the reviewed commit by repository ruleset 24444361; source.commitSha is not treated as effective because the provider ignores it.

requiredInputs.MARKETPLACE_INTERNAL_AUTH_TOKEN: Portal-generated server-only service bearer; never a browser or agent credential.
requiredInputs.MARKETPLACE_OPERATOR_ACCESS_TOKEN: Operator recovery/login secret held by the trusted deployment owner.
requiredInputs.MARKETPLACE_OPERATOR_ID: Server-issued operator identity; never derived from a browser label.
requiredInputs.MARKETPLACE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: Exact HTTPS Marketplace origin; wildcard is forbidden.
requiredInputs.MARKETPLACE_PUBLIC_ORIGIN: Exact HTTPS origin used to construct provider OAuth callbacks.
requiredInputs.MARKETPLACE_HANDOFF_ENCRYPTION_KEY: Unique per-instance 32-byte hex or base64url secret, external to SQLite backups.
requiredInputs.MARKETPLACE_PORTAL_ATTACHMENT_AUDIENCE: Portal attachment audience; use marketplace for the current contract.
requiredInputs.MARKETPLACE_PORTAL_INSTANCE_PROOF: Portal-issued per-instance proof used by readiness and handoff calls.
requiredInputs.MARKETPLACE_PORTAL_WORKSPACE_ID: Server-bound Portal workspace identity; must match the product tenant.
requiredInputs.RULES_COMPANY_ID: Rules company/workspace identity; must match the Marketplace tenant scope.

services.name: Marketplace
services.startCommandPolicy: Keep the Dockerfile ENTRYPOINT; do not bypass the volume ownership checks or launch the development source entrypoint.
forbiddenDefaults: provider credentials from an operator or another workspace

remainingGates: Portal creates and verifies the actual Railway template
Railway templateDeployV2 uses the fixed release branch rather than the rejected tag or ignored source.commitSha
Repository ruleset 24444361 remains active and reports no bypass actor
Railway-resolved source identity and customer endpoint
Portal deployment binding and human operator acceptance
A separately authorized community-scoped GitHub repository-list canary
